renders_note: renders/ is git-ignored. Rebuild with the commands below from videos/nitelos-launch/.
audio_target: -16 LUFS integrated, true peak <= -1 dBTP, measured with ffmpeg loudnorm after mastering

videos.render: tools/stage.sh index.html render --quality delivery --output "$(pwd -W)/renders/nitelos-main-30s.raw.mp4" && tools/master.sh renders/nitelos-main-30s.raw.mp4 renders/nitelos-main-30s.mp4 17.2 stills/nitelos-main-poster.jpg

tools/stage.sh demo.html render --quality delivery --output "$(pwd -W)/renders/nitelos-demo-60s.raw.mp4" && tools/master.sh renders/nitelos-demo-60s.raw.mp4 renders/nitelos-demo-60s.mp4 20.5 stills/nitelos-demo-poster.jpg

tools/stage.sh vertical.html render --quality delivery --output "$(pwd -W)/renders/nitelos-vertical-30s.raw.mp4" && tools/master.sh renders/nitelos-vertical-30s.raw.mp4 renders/nitelos-vertical-30s.mp4 17 stills/nitelos-vertical-poster.jpg

tools/stage.sh teaser.html render --quality delivery --output "$(pwd -W)/renders/nitelos-teaser-8s.raw.mp4" && tools/master.sh renders/nitelos-teaser-8s.raw.mp4 renders/nitelos-teaser-8s.mp4 4.5 stills/nitelos-teaser-poster.jpg

videos.seamless: frame 179 vs frame 0 PSNR 48.98 dB; 3x concatenation in renders/nitelos-loop-6s.x3.mp4 (18.0 s)
videos.render: tools/stage.sh loop.html render --quality delivery --output "$(pwd -W)/renders/nitelos-loop-6s.raw.mp4" && ffmpeg -i renders/nitelos-loop-6s.raw.mp4 -an -c:v libx264 -crf 18 -preset slow -pix_fmt yuv420p -movflags +faststart renders/nitelos-loop-6s.mp4 && ffmpeg -i renders/nitelos-loop-6s.raw.mp4 -an -c:v libvpx-vp9 -b:v 0 -crf 32 -row-mt 1 renders/nitelos-loop-6s.webm

stills.render: diagram-png.html snapshot --at 0.5,1.5 (copy docs/assets/how-it-works-*.svg to assets/diagram/ first)

brand.generator: uv run --with fonttools --with uharfbuzz --with skia-pathops python tools/brand.py
brand.svg_generator: uv run python tools/diagram.py (diagram SVGs + state-card SVGs)
